# FTN ibis — FTN Platform

FTN ibis (short name: ibis) is a Caribbean-first intelligence, intent and execution network created under the direction of Ricardo Gill (publicly known as Ricardo Antoine / Rick Boss) through FTN Platform.

Important truth boundary:

- ibis is not consciousness transfer or a sentience claim.
- Founder Resonance is not authentication or authorization.
- External actions require real adapters, identity and permission.
- The Gill Cohesive Consciousness Hypothesis is speculative research only.
